info.title: MGMD_PGS
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

mgmd_last_reporter.description: IP address of the host which last reported the group.

excluded_source_count.description: Count of sources requested to be excluded for the Group on the port. Only applicable when source is 0.0.0.0/0::0.  An empty entry indicates a count of 0.

requested_source_count.description: Count of sources requested to be included for the Group on the port. Only applicable when source is 0.0.0.0/0::0.  An empty entry indicates a count of 0.

mgmd_type.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_PGS](#/MGMD_PGS)
Type represents whether the entry is for IGMP or MLD.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_PGS](#/MGMD_PGS)
[Port](#/Port) on which the group or group, source entry is created.

source_ip.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_PGS](#/MGMD_PGS)
Source address from which multicast group traffic is requested to be included or excluded.

state.description: 'include': Group or group, source in INCLUDE mode. 'exclude': Group or group, source in EXCLUDE mode. 'static':  Group configured as static-group.

timers_absolute.description: Group timers or group, source timers in seconds added with the system uptime. System uptime is the switch bootup time (number of seconds since bootup). The system uptime is added to the timers so that the timer values don't need to be updated every clock tick.

create_time.description: Time when the PGS entry was created.

exclude_mode_expiry_time.description: This timer is used when the group on the port is in EXCLUDE mode and when this timer expires, the group will move to INCLUDE mode.

expiry_time.description: Time when the PGS entry will expire.

older_v1_host_expiry_time.description: Time at which the group on the port will transition back to IGMPv3/IGMPv2. The timer is initiated on receiving an older IGMPv1 report. This timer is applicable only for IGMP.

older_v2_host_expiry_time.description: Time at which the group on the port will transition back to IGMPv3/MLDv2. The timer is initiated on receiving an older IGMPv2/MLDv1 report.

source_expiry_time.description: Expiry time of this source on this port.

version.description: MGMD version for the group or group, source.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
